limits: Activation-selected positives measure conditional redetection, not population recall.
False-positive reductions are paired replay counts, not FP/hour.
Old sets and old splits are known regression data, not new blind validation.
New temporal splits share one short session; independence and generalization are limited.
Local acoustic/ASR screening does not constitute human phonetic alignment.
One-LSB runtime diagnostic remains unchanged even when baseline fails.
Resources and paired latency are advisory; no new post-test threshold or resource limit is introduced.
Host native replay does not establish physical ARM64 compatibility; prospective physical testing remains pending.
Only6new training originals;36derived windows and1024presentations per fit remain6dependent observations.
Corpus source mix, BN freeze, learning rate and positive inclusion changed together; no causal isolation of positive addition alone.
No human listening or phonetic annotation; template acceptance is anchored to human event labels, not an independent classifier.
decision_scope: Experimental evidence for the sealed selected candidate only; no automatic production replacement, Android import, or physical ARM64 homologation.
physical_tests_pending: Physical ARM64 replay/import compatibility and resources.
Prospective continuous collection of known duration, with missed attempted calls annotated.

quality_inspection.method: Human correct label anchors identity, conservative full isolated acoustic component and two reference DTW support; visual review of all6TRAIN. No human listening/certified phonetic annotation.
quality_inspection.revision_limit: Support threshold/admission criterion revised after audio/QA inspection, before first fit; splits unchanged, no training/final detector results used.

execution.aborted_reason: 39720byte export caused by autogenerated names; native requires39552. Repaired export in isolated process; no runtime, architecture or hyperparameter change. First epoch checkpoints byte-identical on restart.

verification.recorded_background_limit: Only1.2s of quiet TRAIN lead-ins; no repetition, cannot establish environmental robustness.
